mapper.sql: SELECT v.id, v.visitor_name, v.phone, v.room_id, v.visit_time, v.leave_time, v.purpose, v.status, v.register_by, v.remark, v.create_time, r.room_no AS roomNo, b.name AS buildingName, u.real_name AS registerByName, o.name AS ownerName FROM t_visitor v LEFT JOIN t_room r ON r.id = v.room_id LEFT JOIN t_building b ON b.id = r.building_id LEFT JOIN t_owner o ON o.id = r.owner_id LEFT JOIN t_user u ON u.id = v.register_by

sql.if: AND (v.visitor_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR v.phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR r.room_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR b.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select: ORDER BY v.visit_time DESC, v.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_visitor v LEFT JOIN t_room r ON r.id = v.room_id LEFT JOIN t_building b ON b.id = r.building_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_visitor (visitor_name, phone, room_id, visit_time, leave_time, purpose, status, register_by, remark, create_time) VALUES (#{visitorName}, #{phone}, #{roomId}, #{visitTime}, #{leaveTime}, #{purpose}, #{status}, #{registerBy}, #{remark}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE t_visitor SET visitor_name = #{visitorName}, phone = #{phone}, room_id = #{roomId}, visit_time = #{visitTime}, leave_time = #{leaveTime}, purpose = #{purpose}, status = #{status}, remark = #{remark} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE t_visitor SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE t_visitor SET status = '已离开', leave_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_visitor WHERE status = #{status}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_visitor WHERE DATE(visit_time) = CURDATE()
